tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page ground behind everything.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Cards, tables, inputs and buttons sitting on paper.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text. Also the Admin tag ground (adm).

tokens.name: ink2
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions and kickers. Never lighter than this and never under 12px.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline borders on cards and between rows.

tokens.name: line2
tokens.usage: Stronger borders: inputs, buttons, neutral tags.

tokens.name: forest
tokens.usage: Primary action, selected state, solid tags, admin bar.

tokens.name: forest-d
tokens.usage: Header band. Stays dark green in both themes.

tokens.name: forest-wash
tokens.usage: Leader row, selected row, the signed-in player.

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: Current page marker and leader mark. A fill or underline only, never text.

tokens.name: clay
tokens.usage: Void, militant, errors and destructive actions.

tokens.name: clay-wash
tokens.usage: Background for clay: militant and void tags, error alerts.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Winner, valid, recorded.

tokens.name: ok-wash
tokens.usage: Background for ok: tags, alerts, selected checkbox and radio rows.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Pending, waitlisted, disputed (text on warn-wash).

tokens.name: warn-wash
tokens.usage: Background for warn: tags and warning alerts.

tokens.name: warn-ink
tokens.usage: Body text inside a warning alert.

tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: Insurgent and information (text on blue-wash).

tokens.name: blue-wash
tokens.usage: Background for blue: insurgent tags and info alerts.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links and ghost buttons.

tokens.name: adm
tokens.usage: Ground of the Admin tag. Text on it is paper.

tokens.name: sel
tokens.usage: Border of a selected checkbox or radio row.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring on paper and cards. 3px, 2px offset, on every interactive element.

tokens.name: focus-on-band
tokens.usage: Focus ring on the dark header band.

tokens.name: discord
tokens.usage: The Continue with Discord button only.

tokens.name: band-text
tokens.usage: Nav links and secondary text on the header band.

tokens.name: band-line
tokens.usage: Outline of buttons on the header band.

tokens.name: band-adm
tokens.usage: Ground of the admin bar under the header band.

tokens.name: band-adm-text
tokens.usage: Text on the admin bar.
